plugin.name: Host Icons
plugin.description: Give each host in the Hosts list its own icon and color.

help.label: Priority order
help.order: The host's own icon, color and badge come first. If it has none, the folder default applies, then your user default, then the server default.
help.rules: Rules apply from top to bottom and the first one that applies wins. Without Priority, a rule fills in only what the host lacks after defaults. With Priority, what the rule sets replaces the host's own or default.
help.badge: A rule's badge is drawn only on a host that ends up with an icon.

position.label: Icon position
position.description: Where host icons show in the Hosts list.

size.label: Icon size
size.description: How big host icons are in the Hosts list, from 50% to 150%.

skipEmptySlot.label: Indent only hosts with an icon
skipEmptySlot.description: With large icons, only hosts that have one move over. Turn this off to give hosts without an icon an empty space so all names line up.

folderSize.label: Folder icon size
folderSize.description: How big folder icons are in the Hosts list, from 75% to 200% of their usual size. Works with the Classic Layout.

rules.label: Automatic icons
rules.description: Give hosts an icon, color or badge by tag or name. The first rule that applies wins; turn on Priority to replace the host's own.

library.label: Uploaded icons
library.description: Add, rename and delete the icons everyone on this server can pick for a host.

icon.label: Icon
icon.description: Shown next to the host name in the Hosts list.

color.label: Icon color
color.description: The color of the icon in the Hosts list.

badge.label: Corner badge
badge.description: A small circle at the bottom right of the icon, with one or two characters or just a dot.

badgeColor.label: Badge color
badgeColor.description: Color of the badge circle. Theme color follows the text color of the list.

picker.unknown: This host has an icon this version does not know. It shows as {{fallback}} until you pick another one.

rules.empty: No rules yet. Add one to give hosts an icon by tag, name or regular expression.
rules.invalidRegex: Not a valid regular expression, so the rule is off
rules.overrideLabel: Rule {{n}} takes priority over the host's icon
rules.lookDescription: Pick the icon, color and badge this rule gives.
rules.priorityTip: Replaces the host's own icon, color and badge, and defaults
rules.handleLabel: Reorder rule {{n}}: drag, or hold Alt and press Up or Down
rules.noIconTip: No icon: only the color or badge is added, the host keeps its own icon

dialog.title: Icon for {{name}}
dialog.description: Shown next to the host name in the Hosts list.
dialog.ruleNote: Rule "{{rule}}" gives this host an icon while it has none.
dialog.ruleOverrideNote: Rule "{{rule}}" sets the icon, color or badge shown for this host.

custom.deleteDescription: Hosts that use this icon will show the fallback icon. Everyone sharing the library loses it.

errors.type: Only SVG and PNG files can be uploaded.
errors.unreadable: The file could not be read.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to do that.
errors.full: The icon library is full. Delete an icon first.
errors.name: The name must be 1 to 64 characters.
errors.pixels: The image is too large in pixels.
errors.invalid: This file is not a valid or safe icon.

custom.manageDescription: Add, rename and delete the icons in the shared library.
custom.nameInvalid: Enter a name of 1 to {{max}} characters.

upload.title: Upload icons
upload.description: Add icons to the shared library and rename or delete your own.

manage.title: Manage uploaded icons
manage.description: Rename or delete icons that other people uploaded.

layers.needIcon: Pick an icon first: the badge is drawn on top of it.
